verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows Calendly's pricing page (calendly.com/pricing) lists tier-specific feature sets (recordings/transcripts, AI assistant, payments, round-robin scheduling, etc.) suggesting a published, feature-differentiated tier structure, but none of the first-party citations in this pack state the actual per-seat dollar figures. Only community comments (calendly-comm-7, calendly-comm-8) mention concrete prices ($8/$12/user/month vs $16/$20/user/month), and these figures diverge without clear tier alignment, undermining confidence that a buyer can read exact costs directly from official docs alone. Missing for 10: explicit official pricing-page evidence citing dollar amounts per tier, and confirmation that community-reported prices match current official tiers without contradiction.
